product_overview: Sistema Santa Cruz is a role-based school administration platform that centralizes authentication, institution context, user management, and institutional communication. It supports authenticated access to institution-scoped records for administrators, staff, students, and guardians.
core_goals: Authenticate users securely and expose the current user profile
Allow privileged users to manage institutions and switch active institution context
Support administrative user management across roles and institutions
Enable publication and retrieval of institutional announcements
Provide event scheduling and calendar views scoped to the institution and academic year

features.name: Authentication and Profile Switching
features.description: Lets users log in, retrieve their authenticated profile, and switch the active institution context for multi-institution access.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with JWT access token, refresh token, and user payload -> GET /auth/me with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
GET /auth/me without a token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /auth/switch-institution with Bearer token and valid institutionId -> Receive 200 with updated user context and active institution
POST /auth/switch-institution with Bearer token but institutionId not linked to user -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Institution Management
features.description: Allows authorized administrators to list, create, and update institutions, including their contact details and related institutional structure.
user_flows: GET /institutions with Bearer token and valid filters -> Receive 200 with paginated institution list
POST /institutions with Bearer token and valid name, CNPJ, email, and phone -> Receive 201 with created institution record
PATCH /institutions/:id with Bearer token and updated fields -> Receive 200 with updated institution record
POST /institutions with missing or invalid required fields -> Receive 400 Validation error
PATCH /institutions/:id for a non-existent institution -> Receive 404 Institution not found
GET /institutions without required authorization -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: User Administration
features.description: Supports administrative listing, creation, and retrieval of user profiles across roles and institutions.
user_flows: GET /users with Bearer token and optional role or institution filters -> Receive 200 with paginated user list
POST /users with Bearer token and valid firstName, lastName, email, role, and institutionId -> Receive 201 with created user profile
GET /users/:id with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with user profile details
POST /users with invalid payload or missing required fields -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /users/:id for a user that does not exist -> Receive 404 User not found
GET /users with Bearer token but insufficient permissions or inconsistent role scope -> Receive 400 Validation error or false error state in UI

features.name: Announcements and Communication
features.description: Enables authorized staff to create, publish, and retrieve active announcements visible to the current audience.
user_flows: POST /announcements with Bearer token and valid title, content, targetRoles, and institutionId -> Receive 201 with created announcement
PATCH /announcements/:id/publish with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with announcement marked published or scheduled
GET /announcements/active with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with active announcements for the current user
POST /announcements with invalid payload -> Receive 400 Validation error
PATCH /announcements/:id/publish when announcement state is invalid -> Receive 400 Invalid state
GET /announcements/active without authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /announcements/active or publish flows as SUPER_ADMIN_GLOBAL when backend authorization fallback is missing -> Receive 400 or 403 instead of successful access

features.name: Events Calendar
features.description: Allows users to create institutional events and view upcoming or monthly calendar entries scoped by institution and academic year.
user_flows: POST /events with Bearer token and valid title, type, startDate, and academicYearId -> Receive 201 with created event
GET /events/upcoming with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with upcoming events for the next N days
GET /events/calendar/:year/:month with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with events for the requested month
POST /events with invalid or incomplete event data -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /events/upcoming without authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /events/calendar/:year/:month or POST /events as SUPER_ADMIN_GLOBAL when backend authorization fallback is missing -> Receive 400 or 403 instead of successful access

known_limitations.issue: SUPER_ADMIN_GLOBAL support is not fully implemented in the backend authorization for announcements and events endpoints.
known_limitations.impact: Global admins may receive 400/403 responses in API-driven communication screens unless the frontend applies a fallback.

known_limitations.issue: User retrieval endpoints in the deployed API are inconsistent for some role-based flows such as DIRECTOR creation follow-up and filtered listing.
known_limitations.impact: Administrative flows can save successfully but still surface false error states in the UI.
